prose: Emily Ridout is a multi-disciplinary scholar and teacher of Astrology, Yoga, and Folklore. Join us to learn about the Inner Zodiac, how various parts of your body connect with the constellations, and what movements correlate to Astrological signs. As above, so below & as within, so without!
topics: Types of astrology: Hellenistic, Jyotish & Tropical
Saturn returns and Yoga for your inner Saturn
The body part correlations to the 12 signs
Accessing Pisces creativity through the feet
Becoming more like your sun sign
